title: Default theme
summary: Required theme plugin. First-install is white/near-black (light) and the same system grayed darker (dark). Configure overlays merchant hexes.
configure: Admin, Plugins, Default theme, Configure. Swatches start at white, near-black ink, black accent. Save writes store.theme via PATCH /admin/store. Empty tokens keep CSS light-dark() as the shipped default.
preferences: No Preferences entry. Theme tokens are not Boutique fields.
cart: No cart impact. Layout chrome (header, burger, bottom bar) consumes CSS variables.

sections.heading: How pages consume it
paragraphs: ThemeTokens in the shop applies bootstrap.theme.tokens only when the merchant saved Configure hexes. An empty token map leaves CSS light-dark() in charge, so light and dark both work. Product pages do not hard-code brand colours. Only one theme should be enabled.
